walkthroughs.body_html:
HL Regional Option: History of Africa & the Middle East — a core area of History.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

HL Regional Option: History of Africa & the Middle East brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with HL Regional Option: History of Africa & the Middle East.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How successful were Stalin's Five Year Plans?
options: Germany declared war on Britain to seize colonies.
The Five Year Plans turned the USSR into the most prosperous country in the world.
Heavy industry and steel output grew dramatically; consumer goods, quality and worker conditions lagged badly; statistics were inflated, but the USSR became an industrial power.
The Five Year Plans were Lenin's last great achievement.
